  • Desenvolver apresentações estratégicas sobre desempenho de preços (QBR, MMR).
  • Contribuir para o desenho do AOP e planejamento de investimentos comerciais.
  • Garantir conformidade com Controles Internos e apoiar Auditorias Externas.
  • Apoiar o roadmap de implementação da estratégia de Reforma Tributária, em estreita colaboração com equipes multifuncionais.
  • Construir estratégias de precificação personalizadas por segmento, conectando valor percebido, elasticidade e competitividade.
  • Gerenciar 2 subordinados diretos e promover ações para melhorar o engajamento com base nos aprendizados do Gallup. Treinar e orientar membros juniores da equipe conforme necessário.

Qualificações

  • Superior Completo em Administração, Ciências Econômicas, Engenharia, ou áreas correlatas;
  • Pós Graduação e/ou MBA (diferencial);
  • Inglês avançado/fluente (mandatório);
  • Ampla experiência em cargos de liderança em GRM, preferencialmente no setor de FMCG;
  • Fortes habilidades de comunicação e gestão de stakeholders, com capacidade de influenciar equipes multifuncionais;
  • Sólido entendimento de processos de vendas, planejamento promocional e gestão de canais;
  • Alta atenção aos detalhes e capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas prioridades em um ambiente dinâmico;
  • Perfil proativo, colaborativo e orientado a resultados.

Informações adicionais

Contamos com um programa de benefícios flexíveis em que você poderá personalizar seus benefícios de acordo com seu momento e estilo de vida.

  • Assistência Médica;
  • Assistência Odontológica;
  • Previdência Privada;
  • Vale Alimentação;
  • Vale Refeição;
  • Reembolso de Pedágio;
  • Desconto de Produtos;
  • Programa Grãos do Futuro (assistência e licença estendida para famílias gestantes e adotantes);
  • Plano de Saúde Pet.

Nossa declaração de Diversidade, Equidade & Inclusão

Na JDE Peet's, nosso propósito é criar um futuro melhor, no qual servimos, refletimos e abraçamos todos em suas autenticidades. Acreditamos na promoção de uma organização mais diversa, equitativa e inclusiva, em que todos se sintam confortáveis para serem, verdadeiramente, quem são e possam despertar todo o seu potencial. Isto significa que não toleramos qualquer tipo de discriminação com base em raça ou etnia, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, religião, nacionalidade, idade, deficiência ou qualquer outra característica diversa e protegida por lei.

Ao longo de todo o ciclo de vida dos associados, priorizamos DE&I no centro dos nossos processos de pessoas. Isso nos permite promover o respeito e eliminar qualquer preconceito ou ação discriminatória, garantindo uma experiência inclusiva no ambiente de trabalho. Não hesite em entrar em contato se precisar de qualquer suporte durante o processo de recrutamento.

Nossos esforços nessa agenda nos renderam o prestigioso Prêmio Catalyst e a Certificação Fair Pay Leader 2025, reconhecimento pelo nosso compromisso com a equidade salarial, refletido em uma diferença de gênero global de apenas 0,52%.

#DesperteSuasPossibilidades #UmaXícaradeMomentosIncríveis #LI-Hybrid

Descrição da empresa

Quem somos nós?

Somos a JDE Peet’s. Nós produzimos um café para cada xícara e desenvolvemos marcas para cada coração.

A JDE Peet’s é a principal empresa global dedicada exclusivamente ao café, servindo aproximadamente 4.400 xícaras de café por segundo em mais de 100 mercados. Guiados pela nossa estratégia “Reviver o Incrível”, focamos em um crescimento liderado por marcas com três grandes apostas: Peet’s, L’OR e Jacobs, além de um portfólio de 9 ícones locais, como Douwe Egberts, Kenco, Pilão, Old Town, Moccona, Super, Gevalia, Friele e Marcilla.

Em 2024, a JDE Peet’s gerou 8,8 bilhões de euros em vendas e contava com mais de 21 mil colaboradores no mundo todo.

No Brasil, somos uma das maiores empresas de café e temos atuação nacional através de nossas marcas Pilão, L’OR, Café do Ponto, Damasco, Café Maratá, Caboclo, Café Pelé, Café Puro, Chá Maratá e Chá Castelari.

Somos pessoas unidas pelas possibilidades de café e chá. Na JDE Peet\'s, nós nos desenvolvemos com a liberdade de buscar oportunidades e de provocar novas ideias para causar um impacto positivo no mundo do café e do chá. Nossa ambição é simples: despertar possibilidades de café e chá. Colocamos em prática nossas intenções, cumprindo o que foi acordado e sempre levando as coisas adiante. Oferecemos aos nossos associados uma série de programas de aprendizado e desenvolvimento para apoiar seu crescimento pessoal.

Na JDE Peet's, acreditamos que é incrível o que acontece ao redor de uma xícara de café ou chá.

Overview

Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: Belo Horizonte, State of Minas Gerais, Brazil; São Paulo, State of São Paulo, Brazil .

Minimum qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred qualifications

  • Master’s degree or PhD in Engineering, Computer Science, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

About The Job

Like Google's own ambitions, the work of a Software Engineer goes way beyond just Search. Software Engineering Managers have not only the technical expertise to take on and provide technical leadership to major projects, but also manage a team of engineers. You not only optimize your own code but make sure engineers are able to optimize theirs. As a Software Engineering Manager you manage your project goals, contribute to product strategy and help develop your team. Teams work all across the company, in areas such as information retrieval, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking, security, data compression, user interface design; the list goes on and is growing every day. Operating with scale and speed, our exceptional software engineers are just getting started -- and as a manager, you guide the way.

With technical and leadership expertise, you manage engineers across multiple teams and locations, a large product budget and oversee the deployment of large-scale projects across multiple sites internationally.

Google is an engineering company at heart. We hire people with a broad set of technical skills who are ready to take on some of technology's greatest challenges and make an impact on users around the world. At Google, engineers not only revolutionize search, they routinely work on scalability and storage solutions, large-scale applications and entirely new platforms for developers around the world. From Google Ads to Chrome, Android to YouTube, social to local, Google engineers are changing the world one technological achievement after another.

Responsibilities

  • Manage a team of software engineers and create a safe environment that enables them to grow.
  • Lead the overall planning, execution, and successful delivery of projects.
  • Provide a clear goal and strategy for the team.
  • Support career development of team members.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. title: IDB Invest - Head of Tourism & Real Estate - Corporates Division
description:
IDB Invest - Head of Tourism & Real Estate - Corporates Division

Location

The position can be based in Washington DC, USA or any IDB Group member country in the Latin America & Caribbean (LAC) region.

We improve lives

IDB Invest is the private sector arm of the IDB Group and an international financial institution committed to addressing the development needs of Latin America and the Caribbean. Our mission is to support sustainable enterprises and projects that deliver financial results while maximizing social and environmental impact in the region.

IDB Invest operates in 26 countries, structured across four geographic regions: Southern Cone (Argentina, Brazil, Chile, Paraguay, Uruguay), Andean Group (Bolivia, Colombia, Ecuador, Peru, Venezuela), Caribbean (The Bahamas, Barbados, Guyana, Jamaica, Suriname, Trinidad and Tobago) and Central America, Haiti, Mexico, Panama, and the Dominican Republic, and three vertical industries: Infrastructure and Energy, Financial Institutions, and Corporates.

In support of a new transformative business model “Originate to Share” our shareholders recently approved a $3.5 billion capitalization. This will allow IDB Invest to significantly scale up its investments, nearly doubling annual financing from approximately $8 billion to $19 billion, and unlocking greater private sector participation to drive development and climate impact across the region.

About This Position

We are looking for a Head of Tourism & Real Estate to join the Corporates Division (SMC) within the Industries and Cross-Cutting Themes Department (ICT) at IDB Invest. You will report to the Managing Director of the Corporates Division (SMC).

ICT is responsible for engaging with clients and partners for the origination, structuring, closing, and supervision of transactions and projects with strong development impact.

SMC, together with the corresponding Regional Division in the Regions Department, leads the origination and delivery of operations in Tourism, Manufacturing, Mining, Digital Economy, Agribusiness & Forestry. Our work spans all 26 countries where IDB Invest operates in Latin America and the Caribbean.

You will lead the institution’s investment strategy across hospitality, leisure, and real estate sectors across Latin America and the Caribbean region. This role is pivotal in shaping the institution’s approach to sustainable urban development, inclusive tourism, and resilient infrastructure, while delivering strong financial returns and measurable development impact. This position will be responsible for developing new business opportunities and leading key client engagements as well as originating highly developmental transactions in the sector.

What you’ll do

  • Spearhead the design and execution of IDB Invest’s tourism and real estate strategy and investment program, working in close collaboration with investment teams to ensure alignment with institutional priorities.
  • Cultivate and maintain strong relationships with leading global and regional clients to generate new investment opportunities. Actively identify and pursue strategic partnerships with different stakeholders that expand IDB Invest’s impact and presence in the mining sector.
  • Collaborate closely with regional investment teams to provide expert sector insights during due diligence processes. This includes evaluating project strengths and weaknesses, defining key performance indicators, analyzing unit economics for integration into financial models, and conducting competitive sector analysis.
  • Lead sectoral engagement with IDB public sector teams and the Regions Department to support governments and authorities in identifying and addressing regulatory and enabling infrastructure gaps. This includes contributing to the development of financially viable and bankable projects and supporting upstream work to help countries build a pipeline of projects in the tourism and real estate sector and their value chains.
  • Lead industry and market research in the tourism and real estate sector to support business origination and execution, ensuring alignment with IDB Invest’s investment strategy.
  • Lead sectoral upstream work and the development of customized sector-specific products, in coordination with the Regions Department and the Products Department, to enhance IDB Invest’s value proposition.
  • Review eligibility and investment proposals, offering well-informed recommendations to the respective regional Director of Corporates and/or Managing Director. Actively contribute to investment decision meetings by addressing inquiries and providing sector-specific insights to guide the decision-making process.
  • Develop and disseminate sector knowledge products and training programs for internal teams and external stakeholders. Ensure consistency and alignment across regions in addressing common industry challenges and risk factors.
  • Lead internal coordination with development partners to address sector-specific challenges, including environmental, social, credit, and reputational risks, as well as development impact. Collaborate with other IDB Invest teams to ensure a cohesive and integrated approach to agribusiness and forestry.
  • Provide support for the development of IDBG Country Strategies and IDB Invest’s multi-year Business Plans, particularly in relation to tourism and real estate.
  • Assist in the selection, briefing and supervision of technical consultants engaged on due diligence, as needed
  • Represent IDB Invest at conferences, seminars, and other relevant events to increase institutional visibility and strengthen sector knowledge, while networking with industry leaders and key stakeholders to stay informed about emerging trends and best practices in the sector.

What you\'ll need

  • Education: An advanced degree (Masters, MBA, or equivalent) in economics, finance, business administration, engineering, or another relevant field. Academic specialization in sustainable tourism is desirable.
  • Experience: You have at least 10 + years of relevant professional experience in the tourism and real estate sector with proven well-established relationships at C-level management of key industry players and other stakeholders. Confirmed experience in a similar role in an investment, advisory firm, or development bank is essential, as well as proven strong client relationship experience and skills. Sound knowledge of current industry and sector operating parameters, as well as regional and global industry trends, risks and opportunities.
  • Language Skills: You are proficient in oral and written English and Spanish; knowledge of Portuguese is a plus.

Requirements

  • Washington DC: No requirements
  • LAC: You are a citizen of one of IDB Group member countries in LAC, or with residency or legal permit to work in one of these countries.
  • Consanguinity: You have no family members (up to the fourth degree of consanguinity and second degree of affinity, including spouse) working at the IDB, IDB Invest, or IDB Lab.

Type of contract and duration

  • Washington DC: International staff contract, 36 months initially, renewable upon mutual agreement.
  • LAC: National staff contract, 36 months initially, renewable upon mutual agreement.

What we offer

The IDB group provides benefits that respond to the different needs and moments of an employee's life. These benefits include:

  • A competitive compensation package.
  • Leaves and vacations: 24 days of paid time off + 8 personal days + sick leave + gender-neutral parental leave.
  • Health Insurance: IDB Group provides employees and eligible dependents with a robust medical benefits program that covers medical, dental, vision, preventive care, and prescription drugs.
  • Pension plan: defined benefit pension plan that provides financial security and support employees in planning for their future.
  • Hybrid and flexible work schedules.
  • Health and well-being: Access to our Health Services Center that provides preventive care and health education for employees.
  • Development support: We offer tools to boost your professional profile, such as mentoring, 1:1 professional counseling, training and learning opportunities, language classes, mobility options, among others.

Our culture

At the IDB, we work so everyone brings their best and authentic selves to work while finding their purpose. Our people consistently strive for excellence, and we recognize and celebrate the impact of their contributions.

In our efforts to drive innovation, we intentionally include all voices, cultivate a sense of belonging and champion fairness. We welcome individuals from underrepresented groups to join us and share their unique perspectives.

We ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations to participate in the job interview process. If you require an accommodation to complete this application, please email us at

    • Trabalhar com social media em chamadas, cortes e ganchos por plataforma.

  • Assegurar a documentação adequada dos processos e a manutenção de ferramentas de gestão (como Jira, Azure DevOps ou Trello).

  • Experiência sólida em gestão de projetos e modelagem de processos de negócio (BPM).

  • Foco em Resultados: Orientação para a entrega de valor real, evitando o "agilismo por agilismo" e focando na eficiência operacional.

title: Product Cost Specialist - Fabric Care
description:
Curitiba-PR

At Electrolux Group, a leading global appliance company, we strive every day to shape living for the better for our consumers, our people and our planet. We share ideas and collaborate so that together, we can develop solutions that deliver enjoyable and sustainable living.

Apply by January 30th.

Power a world of ideas.

Come join us as you are. We believe diverse perspectives make us stronger and more innovative. In our global community of people from 100+ countries, we listen to each other, actively contribute and grow together.

Join us in our exciting quest to build the future home!

About the role

The Costing Function is an organization within Electrolux Finance Operations which is responsible for driving the cost management agenda in New Product Development (NPD) and product lifecycle for all product lines globally. With hundreds of NPD projects on a yearly basis, the team plays an important role in developing next generations’ profitable white appliances.

What you’ll do

As a Product Cost Specialist/Manager, you will be accountable for managing and tracking product cost along the NPD process, leading cross-functional project teams to identify and achieve product cost target, applying state of the art costing methods, systems and processes. Help Electrolux keep shaping living for the better, and we'll help you go further than you ever thought possible.

  • Tracking product cost and managing potential deviations during product development phases to ensure Business Case profit is met
  • Working with Business Area and Product Line to define specification and top‑down target cost
  • Gathering proposals, specifications, historical data, market trends and should cost data from e.g., Cost Modelers, and liaising with stakeholders to determine bottom‑up target cost
  • Leading the product cost workstream within the cross‑functional project team (R&D, PMO, Category, Design, Manufacturing, Procurement, etc.) to track cost and evaluate and close the gap between top‑down and bottom‑up target cost
  • Aligning with stakeholders and supporting management decisions by providing appropriate cost information and data
  • Preparing documentation to share cost assessment and development during the Project Steering Committee in accordance with standard procedure
  • Analyzing supplier quotes and working with Procurement and suppliers to ensure an optimal quotation that meets product cost target
  • Coaching and mentoring stakeholders in good costing practices, to develop costing capabilities cross‑functionally
  • Leading the implementation of the new Ways of Working, tools and methods within each Product Line
  • Applying cost methodologies, tools and appropriate software models and packages to prepare and maintain reliable and accurate data
  • Delivering on functional and project costing KPIs to ensure that the company is achieving cost excellence
  • Working proactively within the Costing Function to develop a best‑in‑class organization and scale it

As part of the culture of continuous improvement, you will be involved in Lean Thinking projects and activities (EMS/C2W).

Who you are

  • Bachelor’s degree in Manufacturing Engineering, Management, Operations Research, Mathematics
  • At least 5‑6 years’ professional experience, preferably in an analytical position in a manufacturing environment or in project management
  • Business acumen and analytical skills with systematic approach to mass data handling, analysis, and interpretation
  • Understanding from key functional areas – procurement, manufacturing & engineering, project management, financial controlling, quality management, research & development
  • Experience from product costing in a product development related context e.g., product cost optimization, value engineering, DFMA, target cost ambition setting
  • Hands‑on experience from using automated cost models, cost database, cost factors, and/or cost estimating related tools
  • Presentation, communication, influencing, and negotiation skills, with the ability to form and maintain good relationships internally and externally with different cultures
  • Project management skills
  • Strategic thinker with detail orientation, who can challenge status quo
  • Knowledge about costing tools like TcPCM, Apriori, etc. is a plus
  • Experience in appliance, electronics industry or contract manufacturer is a plus
  • You are fluent in English

Where you’ll be

You will be based at the Curitiba Factory Plant, located in Guabirotuba. It will be necessary to be available for national and international traveling two to four times a year.

Benefits include:

  • Flexible work hours/hybrid work environment
  • Discounts on our award‑winning Electrolux products and services
  • Family‑friendly benefits such as extended paternity leave (4 weeks)
  • Insurance policy plan
  • Extensive learning opportunities and flexible career path

As part of Electrolux Group, we will continuously invest in you and your development. There are no barriers to where your career could take you.

CREATIVITY IS OUR SUPERPOWER.

It’s our heritage and it’s also our future. Because we don’t just make toys. We create innovative products and experiences that inspire, entertain and develop children through play. Mattel is at its best when every member of our team feels respected, included, and heard—when everyone can show up as themselves and do their best work every day. We value and share an infinite range of ideas and voices that evolve and broaden our perspectives with a reach that extends into all our brands, partners, and suppliers.

Job Description

The Consumer Products Associate will support the development and management categories in the Brazilian market. This role is responsible for strengthening relationships with licensees, supporting product launch planning, analyzing royalty reports, and identifying new business opportunities. The position requires close collaboration with internal regional and global teams, as well as external partners, to achieve royalty growth, category expansion, and reinforce Mattel's brand presence in the market.

What Your Impact Will Be

  • Act as category lead for assigned partners in the region
  • Research, identify and pitch category/brand opportunities to current & prospective clients
  • Secure new deals and negotiate renewals
  • Analyze royalty reports, performance indicators, and market trends, providing insights and identifying opportunities for growth.
  • Partner with licensees to ensure the execution of marketing and trade plans, enhancing brand visibility in events and retail channels.
  • Negotiate deal terms and submit for legal drafting ensuring all relevant approvals have been gathered and all information required is present and correct
  • Liaise with the legal team and licensee on contract drafting
  • Work closely with the Product Development, Creative and Quality & Assurance teams
  • Work closely with Marketing, Digital, PR, teams to develop joint business plans
  • Attend fairs or category-specific shows
  • Support the management of the Hardlines – FMCG and HBA category, ensuring alignment with Mattel’s brand strategies.

Qualifications

What We’re Looking For

  • Bachelor's Degree Marketing or Bachelor's Degree Business Administration or Bachelor's Degree related fields
  • +2 years in commercial areas, preferably in licensing, consumer goods, retail, or FMCG.
  • Previous experience in client/account relationship management is a plus.
  • Previous experience in licensing is a plus.
  • Languages: Advanced English, and fluent in Spanish is a plus.
  • Office Suite: Proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint (intermediate/advanced).
  • Strong analytical skills to interpret financial and sales reports (royalties, revenue).
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.
  • Highly proactive, organized, and results-driven.
  • Ability to work in a multicultural and fast-paced environment.

Additional Information

What It’s Like To Work Here

We collaborate

Being a part of Mattel means being part of one team with shared values and common goals. Every person counts and working closely together always brings better results. Partnership is our process and our collective capabilities is our superpower.

We innovate

At Mattel we always aim to find new and better ways to create innovative products and experiences. No matter where you work in the organization, you can always make a difference and have real impact. We welcome new ideas and value new initiatives that challenge conventional thinking.

We execute

We are a performance driven company. We strive for excellence and are focused on pursuing best in class outcomes. We believe in accountability and ownership and know that our people are at their best when they are empowered to create and deliver results.

Who We Are

Mattel is a leading global toy company and owner of one of the strongest catalogs of children’s and family entertainment franchises in the world. We create innovative products and experiences that inspire, entertain and develop children through play. We engage consumers through our portfolio of iconic brands, including Barbie, Hot Wheels, Fisher-Price, American Girl, Thomas & Friends, UNO and MEGA, as well as other popular intellectual properties that we own or license in partnership with global entertainment companies. Our offerings include film and television content, gaming, music and live events. We operate in 35 locations and our products are available in more than 150 countries in collaboration with the world’s leading retail and ecommerce companies. Since its founding in 1945, Mattel is proud to be a trusted partner in empowering children to explore the wonder of childhood and reach their full potential.

description:
Structural Engineer - Entry to Junior Level

Moffatt & Nichol specializes in large complex waterfront infrastructure projects and is recognized as one of the worldwide leaders in this field. The Rio de Janeiro Office is searching for a Civil Engineer, preferably with a Master’s Degree in Structural engineering, with 2 to 4 years’ industry experience to perform design services. The ideal candidate should have worked as an intern/co‑op or structural engineer in a team environment participating in the production and development of structural concepts, analysis and calculations, construction drawings, services and material specifications, construction support services, and field inspections.

About Moffatt & Nichol

Moffatt & Nichol is a leading infrastructure advisor specializing in the planning and design of facilities that shape and serve our coastlines. Reflecting Moffatt & Nichol’s commitment to design innovation since 1945, Engineering News‑Record (ENR) has ranked the company No. 1 design firm for Marine and Port Facilities in the United States and No. 7 internationally. Moffatt & Nichol's professional staff includes engineers, planners, scientists, and architects who serve our global client base from offices in Europe, the Americas, the Middle East and Asia Pacific. The firm provides clients worldwide with customized service and a level of excellence that have become the firm’s hallmark in three primary practice areas—coastal, environmental, and water resources; ports and harbours; and transportation, bridges, and rail.

Duties And Responsibilities

  • Development of structural analysis, design and detailing of concrete, steel, and timber structures
  • Finite element static and dynamic structural modeling and analysis of structures
  • Assist Senior Engineers with the preparation of design concepts, specifications, schedules, quantity and cost estimates
  • Prepare design calculations and check calculations
  • Coordinate detailed plan details with engineers and drafting technicians
  • Participate in field inspections, reports preparations and in projects of rehabilitation of waterfront structures
  • Works in cooperation with other disciplines on multi‑discipline projects

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s of Science in Civil Engineering is required
  • Master’s of Science in Structural Engineering as a differential
  • Entry level with related internship experience or up to 2 years of industry experience
  • Civil engineer License CREA‑RJ
  • Familiarity with either AutoCAD / MicroStation, SAP2000 and REVIT as a differential
  • All new hires will be required to successfully complete and pass a pre‑employment (post‑offer) background check in compliance with NIST 800‑171

• Please provide cover letter and resume when applying.

Working Conditions

Sedentary for prolonged period of time, interact with clients, and travel occasionally.

Moffatt & Nichol’s EEO Statement

As a global business, Moffatt & Nichol relies on diversity of culture and thought to deliver on our goal of Creative People, Practical Solutions® serving our client needs, and ensures nondiscrimination in all activities. We draw from the world’s best and brightest, regardless of geographic, cultural, or institutional background. This approach enables us to better understand and serve our clients, foster innovation, and create a rich, collaborative work environment. title: Tech Lead, Android Core Product - Porto Alegre, Brazil
description:
The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify’s text-to-speech products to turn whatever they’re reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify’s text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its Design award winner for inclusivity for 2025.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

Overview

With the growth of our Android app, being the most used text-to-speech app in the Play Store, we find the need for a Senior Android Engineer to help us support the new user base as well as work on new and exciting projects to push us forward.

This is a key role and ideal for someone who thinks strategically, enjoys fast‑paced environments, passionate about making product decisions, and has experience building great user experiences that delight users.

We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount.

Our interview process involves several technical interviews and we aim to complete them within 1 week.

What You’ll Do

  • Owning major features and working closely with our design team - take ownership of features inside the app and become responsible of delivering high quality features
  • Shape the future of our Android team
  • Own, maintain and improve reliability metrics for key features
  • Participate in discussions across different teams - Product, Design, Engineering
  • Review pull requests, and support other teammates
  • Handle critical issues or cope with unexpected challenges
  • Take ownership of feature releases and provide nightly builds for the QA team

An Ideal Candidate Should Have

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience
  • Familiarity with Android components
  • Experience building or contributing to at least one Android app
  • Product design intuition and user empathy
  • Drive to push the boundaries of Android UI/UX
  • Understanding of the importance of tests and how to approach writing tests
  • Self‑drive to improve the app and codebase above and beyond what’s outlined in the spec
  • Rock solid experience with Kotlin, Kotlin Coroutines, Kotlin Flow, Dagger 2, MVVM, Clean Architecture, Background Services, Music Player Service, Android Animations, Jetpack Navigation, JUnit tests
  • Excellent communication skills
  • User oriented problem solving approach
  • Driven with continuous feedback from leaders

Bonus

  • Experience building, maintaining, or otherwise contributing to open source projects in Android
  • Experience with iOS, Web or NodeJS

Technologies we use

  • Kotlin
  • Kotlin Coroutines
  • Kotlin Flow
  • Jetpack Navigation
  • Dagger 2
  • Room
  • Custom Views, Canvas & Paint
  • Jetpack Compose
  • JUnit

What We offer

  • A fast‑growing environment where you can help shape the company and product.
  • An entrepreneurial‑minded team that supports risk, intuition, and hustle.
  • A hands‑off management approach so you can focus and do your best work.
  • An opportunity to make a big impact in a transformative industry.
  • Competitive salaries, a friendly and laid‑back atmosphere, and a commitment to building a great asynchronous culture.
  • Opportunity to work on a life‑changing product that millions of people use.
  • Build products that directly impact and support people with learning differences like dyslexia, ADD, low vision, concussions, autism, and more.
  • Work in one of the fastest growing sectors of tech, the intersection of artificial intelligence and audio.
